{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=May 2020}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2018–19 |team=Tulsa Golden Hurricane |sport=Basketball |image=Tulsa Golden Hurricane wordmark.svg |image_size=175 |conference=American Athletic Conference |division= |short_conf=AAC |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=18–14 |conf_record=8–10 |head_coach=[[Frank Haith]] |hc_year = 5th |asst_coach1=[[Ken McDonald (basketball)|Ken McDonald]] |asst_coach2=Kenton Paulino |asst_coach3=[[Shea Seals]] |stadium=[[Reynolds Center]] |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2018–19 American Athletic Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 Tulsa Golden Hurricane men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Tulsa]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Golden Hurricane, led by fifth-year head coach [[Frank Haith]], played their home games at the [[Reynolds Center]] in [[Tulsa, Oklahoma]] as members of the [[American Athletic Conference]]. They finished the season 18–14, 8–10 in AAC play to finish in a tie for seventh place. They lost in the first round of the [[2019 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] to [[2018–19 SMU Mustangs men's basketball team|SMU]]. ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 Tulsa Golden Hurricane men's basketball team|Golden Hurricane]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 19–12, 12–6 in [[2017–18 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to finish in fourth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] to [[2017–18 Memphis Tigers men's basketball team|Memphis]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
